# Portals plugin for Claude Code

Build, manage, and publish [Portals](https://portals.to/) browser games from Claude Code —
the `portals-web-games` MCP server plus skills carrying the platform documentation.

## Install

```sh
claude plugin marketplace add portals-labs/portals-plugin-claude
claude plugin install portals-plugin-claude@portals
```

Restart the session to load it. The MCP server is a self-contained bundle that needs
Node 18+ and no install step.
